elements.element: Upon expiry or termination, Vendor must provide transition assistance.
elements.evidence: The added language applies “[u]pon expiry or termination of this Agreement for any reason” and requires Vendor to “provide transition assistance.”

elements.element: Transition assistance must be available for up to 6 months.
elements.evidence: The clause expressly provides transition assistance “for up to 6 months.”

elements.element: Transition assistance must be provided at Vendor's then-current rates.
elements.evidence: The clause expressly applies “Vendor's then-current rates.”

elements.element: Upon expiry or termination, Vendor must return all Customer Data.
elements.evidence: The clause requires Vendor to “return all Customer Data” following expiry or termination.

elements.element: Vendor must return Customer Data within 30 days of expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: Subsection (b) expressly sets the deadline at “within 30 days of expiry or termination.”

elements.element: Customer Data must be returned in a standard machine-readable format.
elements.evidence: Subsection (b) expressly requires “a standard machine-readable format.”

elements.element: After returning Customer Data, Vendor must delete it.
elements.evidence: Subsection (c) requires Vendor, “after such return,” to “delete Customer Data from its systems.”

elements.element: After deletion, Vendor must certify that Customer Data has been deleted.
elements.evidence: Subsection (c) requires Vendor to “certify such deletion in writing.”

elements.element: Upon expiry or termination, Vendor must provide transition assistance.
elements.evidence: The added language requires transition assistance upon expiry or termination for any reason.

elements.element: Transition assistance must be available for at least 90 days.
elements.evidence: The stated period of up to 6 months encompasses the fallback 90-day transition period.

elements.element: Upon expiry or termination, Vendor must provide an export or return of Customer Data.
elements.evidence: The clause requires Vendor to return all Customer Data following expiry or termination.

elements.element: The Customer Data export or return must occur within 30 days of expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: The clause expressly requires return within 30 days of expiry or termination.

result.reason: The operative redline fully implements the preferred position and therefore also meets the fallback. It leaves the original payment, delivery, and refund provisions unchanged and adds only transition assistance, data return, deletion, and certification obligations responsive to the rule. No contradiction is introduced. The drafting is clear overall, although “for up to 6 months” does not specify who determines the actual assistance period.
